content.comment_body: Since Firmware [version_no], access to [product_name] TD is not possible. Error displayed: '[product_name]_td_01.shtm not found!' On earlier Firmware versions, TD functionality was available. Firmware below [version_no] allows access to [product_name] TD. On Firmware [version_no], [product_name] TD cannot be found. Tested with [product_name] software versions such as [product_name]Soft [version_no] and [product_name]SoftComfort [version_no] with respective parameters.

It seems there is some confusion. Opening the web server in a browser and choosing the '[product_name] TD' menu does not represent the physical TDE—it refers to the virtual TDE. The actual TDE cannot be accessed in a browser via its IP address like you can with the web interface of the basic [product_name] module.

Yes, the discussion concerns the virtual TDE. With Firmware [version_no], the message 'Not found' is shown instead of the virtual TDE, which was functional with older Firmware. This appears as if a page is missing in the [product_name].

From my experience, older and newer TDEs cannot be directly accessed in a browser using their IP address. Starting with TDEs with article numbers [article_no], scanning and configuration are possible using [product_name] software version [version_no] or above.

After further testing with another [product_name] module, the issue was resolved. Performing a full reset with power off for several minutes, then retransferring the program and web server, restored functionality. Thanks for the support.

analysis.insight_summary: Users noticed that after updating to Firmware [version_no], the virtual Text Display Emulator was inaccessible through the browser, leading to missing page errors. This problem did not occur with earlier firmware, suggesting a compatibility issue introduced in the recent update. The situation was corrected through a complete hardware reset and reloading of program and web server data.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the virtual Text Display Emulator to remain accessible via the browser as with previous firmware versions, without encountering errors or absent features.
